entities.name: Vo Nguyen Giap
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Vietnamese general (1911–2013) who defeated both France and the United States in consecutive wars. His victory at Dien Bien Phu in 1954 ended French colonial rule in Indochina, and his strategy of protracted people's war ultimately unified Vietnam in 1975. A self-taught military genius, he is considered one of the greatest guerrilla warfare strategists in history.
